title: 自备歌词 · 英文独立流行
note: 官方可用 [Verse]/[Chorus]。不要塞受版权保护的词。普通话歌词没有官方语言表。
expected: 按你给的词唱的英文独立流行短单。

config.prompt: Create a dreamy indie pop song, 90 seconds, with the lyrics below. Soft female vocals, warm guitars, gentle drums.
config.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Walking through the neon glow,
city lights reflect below,
every shadow tells a story,
every corner, fading glory.

[Chorus]
We are the echoes in the night,
burning brighter than the light,
hold on tight, don't let me go,
we are the echoes down below.
